title: AMASS: Archive of Motion Capture as Surface Shapes
summary: AMASS v1 unifies 15 optical marker-based motion-capture datasets by fitting a common SMPL-H surface representation with MoSh++, including body shape, pose, hands, marker placement, and soft-tissue dynamics.

metadata.license_note: The paper and AMASS data/software have separate terms; no paper text, model, or data is redistributed.
